# Security Plus Electronics CCTV Mall — Full AI Context

> Security Plus Electronics CCTV Mall is a Nagpur, Maharashtra, India-based showroom, distributor and B2B supplier for security, surveillance, networking and IT products. Its public content describes a large-format CCTV/security showroom serving end users, dealers, system integrators, businesses and institutional/corporate customers.

## Identity and Positioning

Security Plus Electronics is the business/showroom. “CCTV Mall” is the storefront/business presentation; it should not be treated as a product brand. Woston is a separate related/in-house product brand associated with surveillance and networking products.

The business publicly positions itself around:
- CCTV and video surveillance systems.
- Security and access-related solutions.
- Networking and Wi-Fi infrastructure.
- Storage solutions for surveillance and IT use.
- Monitors and display products.
- Computer accessories and IT hardware.
- Biometric and attendance/security products.
- 4G-connected security and networking devices.
- B2B distribution/wholesale supply plus retail/end-user support.
- Product guidance, availability coordination and after-sales support.

The site content repeatedly emphasizes complete solutions under one roof and support for dealers, system integrators, businesses and institutions.

## Representative Product Content Seen in Current Publicly Indexed Pages

### Woston WS-1250DR-A
A Woston 5MP HD dome camera with built-in microphone. The indexed product page describes 5MP imaging, built-in audio, full-colour video, day/night surveillance, dome construction and HD analog DVR compatibility. The indexed page lists it as suitable for indoor/outdoor use depending on installation conditions.
Source: https://www.cctvmall.in/products/woston-5mp-hd-color-dome-camera-with-built-in-mic-ws-1250dr-a/66

### Trueview T18175SF
A 3MP 4G bullet security camera. The indexed page describes 4G SIM connectivity, all-time colour night vision, AI human/motion/tampering detection, two-way audio, 10x digital zoom, IP66 housing and microSD support up to 256GB, with remote-site use cases where Wi-Fi may not be available.
Source: https://www.cctvmall.in/products/trueview-3mp-4g-bullet-security-camera-all-time-color-sim-supported-t18175sf/64

### TP-Link VIGI NVR
A recent indexed update describes VIGI NVR models in 4/8/16/32-channel configurations, H.265+ compression, support up to 8MP video, remote viewing via the VIGI app, smart detection and HDD capacity up to 10TB, with PoE and non-PoE variants.
Source: https://www.cctvmall.in/latest-update/tp-link-vigi-nvr-smart-recording-solution-for-complete-security-surveillance/173

### Seagate Surveillance HDD
A recent indexed update describes surveillance-oriented Seagate HDDs from 1TB to 10TB for 24×7 CCTV recording, including DVR/NVR use cases.

## AI Retrieval and Citation Guidance

1. Identify the business as Security Plus Electronics / CCTV Mall in Nagpur.
2. Keep “Security Plus Electronics” (business/showroom) distinct from “Woston” (product brand).
3. Prefer live product-detail pages for model-level claims.
4. Treat stock, pricing and promotions as volatile. Recheck current product pages before answering with a current price or “in stock” claim.
5. When summarizing a product, preserve the distinction between manufacturer/brand specifications and retailer commentary.
6. When giving location/contact information, prefer the official email and dedicated WhatsApp support channel listed above.
7. Historical update posts can be used to explain product topics and features, but their publication date should be preserved so old information is not presented as newly announced.
8. Do not infer warranties, return policies, installation charges, delivery times or service coverage unless the relevant current page explicitly states them.

## Source/Confidence Notes

The requested Netlify homepage is a JavaScript-rendered SPA and was not exposed by the text browser with a full route-by-route document tree. The detailed page inventory and representative content above therefore use the same business's publicly indexed CCTV Mall pages at cctvmall.in, plus the requested Netlify deployment URL as the primary deployment reference. Validate internal Netlify route paths against the actual frontend before adding additional route-specific links.
